questions.prompt: Describe your 12-week cycle in one sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Write a brief, build an A/B plan with the programme builder, learn for four weeks, build for four, push for three, log every session and review every four weeks, then re-test in week 12 and write the next brief.

questions.prompt: Explain the course loop in your own words.
questions.modelAnswer: Plan from a brief, train and log every session, check weekly, review every four weeks with one change, and re-test every twelve weeks to write the next plan.
